profile.headline: Software Engineer at Schwab
profile.summary:
I have 26 years experience within IT, having spent 20 of those years designing, building, and maintaining reporting systems, CMDB systems, and other critical enterprise applications.

I have many skills to draw from, but my most recent projects included Python, Django framework, Ext.JS framework, Mysql, MongoDB, REST APIs, Docker, and AWS. This was in an Agile development setting with a daily stand-up call revolving around a 3 week cycle.

I'm a husband and father of 3 adult children. In my free time, I'm a musician, cyclist, and enjoy birding with my wife.

positions.title: Pincipal Software Engineer
positions.description: I currently develop and support internal tools for management and operations.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Doing development work on mission critical proprietary in-house applications.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Was an important part of a small team which developed and maintained an in-house CMDB system,with integrations to many other internal tools.
• Worked with internal customers to develop, enhance, and fix end-to-end features that implementedbusiness logic.
• Built and ran an ADDM replacement system, which discovered hosts and VMs throughout our physicaldata centers.

positions.title: Principal Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Splunk expert tasked to help internal customers build reports and dashboards to make sense of theirdata and teaching best practices.
• Built and ran a system for monitoring Splunk license usage by customers and predicting excessivevolume and preventing cost over-runs.
• Implemented Catchpoint tests for internal customers to allow for availability and other SLA monitoring.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and ran web analytics systems, leveraging PHP, Node.JS, Highcharts and REDIS.
• Worked cross teams on data projects, including collection, aggregation, and reporting processes.
• Held responsibility for some project management tasks, including requirements gathering,documentation, facilitation of work estimates, risk identification and mitigation, resource allocation, andcommunication with interested parties

positions.title: Technical Manager
positions.description:
• Lead a team of 5 software developers; provided coaching & evaluations.
• Built and ran business systems on various database platforms which, saved the company $1M over 2years by reducing contracted services
• Tripled the capacity of our performance metrics database, increasing from 500 MB to 1.5 TB
• Provided some project management work.
• Implemented infrastructure monitoring, reducing system outages.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed as a project lead to numerous projects, including internal tools for system administrators,KPI tracking, and metrics systems.
• Provided build-versus-buy analyses for various projects.
• Worked with vendors and consultants.
• Was recognized in 2003 and 2005 for outstanding contributions.

positions.title: Quality Test Specialist
positions.description:
• Performed quality engineering testing and documentation for software applications according to SDLCguidelines
• Developed a bug tracking system that was used for 5 years by the QA department
• Was recognized in 1996 for outstanding contributions.

courses.name: Cloudera Developer Training for Apache Hadoop

volunteerExperiences.description:
Board member with a nonprofit, which teaches and enables outdoor activities and promotes active living. In my service as a board member, I was an adviser of web and technology matters.

Active: Oct '11 - Oct '13
